name: ipdata
summary: IP geolocation with ASN, company, mobile carrier, time zone, currency and threat data (Tor, proxy, VPN, datacenter, known attacker or abuser, blocklists), plus detailed ASN records.

host.description: API host: the default, or eu-api.ipdata.co to keep requests on EU servers only.

api_key.description: An ipdata API key (ipdata.co dashboard). Sent as the api-key query parameter.

notes: A free key allows 1,500 requests a day, with commercial use restricted; quotas reset at 00:00 UTC. Past the free quota requests are blocked.
Private and reserved addresses return 400 with a message, not a result.
Bulk lookup (POST /bulk with a JSON array of up to 100 IPs, paid plans only, one credit per IP) is not in this entry.

endpoints.name: Look up an IP's location, network and threat profile
endpoints.summary: City, region, country, coordinates, postal code, ASN, company, carrier, languages, currency, time zone, threat flags and anycast/satellite/leased flags for an IP.

fields.description: Comma-separated top-level fields to return, e.g. ip,city,country_name,threat.

notes: One request from the daily quota. threat.is_vpn is filled only on Business and Enterprise plans.

endpoints.name: Get one section of an IP's record
endpoints.summary: A single field of an IP's record, such as threat, company, carrier, asn, time_zone or country_name.
notes: A plain field such as country_name comes back as bare text, not JSON. threat holds is_tor, is_vpn, is_icloud_relay, is_proxy, is_datacenter, is_anonymous, is_known_attacker, is_known_abuser, is_threat, is_bogon, blocklists and scores.

endpoints.name: Get an ASN's details
endpoints.summary: Owner name, domain, usage type, IPv4 and IPv6 prefixes, IP count, registry, country, assignment date, status and upstream, downstream and peer ASNs.

asn.description: The AS number with its AS prefix.
